change.policy: One process-wide weighted admission budget of 192 MiB, estimated at five bytes per decoded pixel. Context cancellation interrupts admission waits. Full image.Decode remains required and accepted bytes persist unchanged; reservations release before storage I/O.
change.measured_fixture_admission: Two 16.384 MP fixtures fit within the estimated budget; a single raster estimate above the budget is rejected before full raster allocation.
change.limitation: Estimated decode admission is not a hard bound on active PSS, decoder implementation overhead, retained heap, or browser/driver memory. Managed API+driver concurrent peak remains unmeasured.
